Home / Client Success / Transit Flow Logistics

Transit Flow Logistics

High-performance, fully responsive business landing page for a modern logistics provider. Designed in Figma, converted to production-quality React components.

React Figma CSS Modules Performance Optimization
// the challenge

Business Challenge

This internal project explored the full Figma-to-production pipeline - converting a designer's pixel-perfect Figma mockups into production-grade React components with zero visual regression, sub-2-second load times, and full responsive coverage from 320px to 2560px viewports.

// our approach

Engineering Approach

Starting from a detailed Figma design file, every component was built as an isolated React module with CSS Modules for scoped styling. The build pipeline includes automated Lighthouse CI checks to enforce performance budgets. Image assets were optimised through responsive srcset definitions with AVIF/WebP fallbacks. Layout was implemented using CSS Grid with carefully calibrated breakpoints matching the Figma artboard sizes.

Business Results & Metrics

  • Pixel-Perfect Figma Parity
    Zero visual regression between Figma designs and deployed components across all responsive breakpoints.
  • Sub-2-Second Load Time
    Automated Lighthouse CI enforcement maintaining 95+ performance scores across mobile and desktop audits.
  • Full Responsive Coverage
    Seamless layout adaptation from 320px mobile to 2560px ultrawide viewports with no horizontal scrolling or layout breaks.
